title: Junk Removal Work Order
subtitle: Residential Junk Removal: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Junk Removal Work Order covers removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream. The removal service coordinator records Residential Junk Removal authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Junk Removal Work Order keeps Residential Junk Removal exceptions visible until the removal service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Junk Removal Work Order at residence, removal zone, carry path, loading point, and approved destination. Document removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream identity before Residential Junk Removal begins. Compare removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream findings with stated Residential Junk Removal criteria; route unresolved Residential Junk Removal issues to waste-routing operations reviewer. For Junk Removal Work Order, confirm requirements for Residential Junk Removal. Ask waste-routing operations reviewer to review Residential Junk Removal conditions beyond the removal service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Customer, provider, and approved-work evidence
sections.guidance: For Residential Junk Removal, identify responsible parties, residence, removal zone, carry path, loading point, and approved destination, and the linked removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream source.

sections.title: Authorized work and completion entries
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Junk Removal facts for removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Junk Removal conditions; have removal service coordinator assign the next Residential Junk Removal owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Junk Removal when material identity, safe handling, access, property protection, or lawful destination remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Junk Removal proof and route unresolved removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream scope to removal service coordinator.
